    original = [1, 2, 3, 4]
    deranged = list(mit.random_derangement(original))
    is_derangement = all((orig != new for orig, new in zip(original, deranged)))
    same_length = len(original) == len(deranged)
    is_permutation = sorted(original) == sorted(deranged)
    return is_derangement and same_length and is_permutation
